records.name: Centurio Brüllus Maximus
records.biography_en: Brüllus commands the HyperNorm landing with a short sword and an objection already in progress. A card suggesting that discipline can include listening receives another unequal mouthful of orders: a resident is either attentive or disobedient. Men in Black admire his projection. He pauses only when the echo sounds sufficiently authoritative to deserve hearing out.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Befehl wurde erteilt. Das Echo beantragt Vorrang.

variant_notes.note_en: He believes a sufficiently forceful instruction will eventually acquire a clear meaning.

records.name: Optio Seitenblicka
records.biography_en: Seitenblicka stands beside the HyperNorm notice board with a staff that needs no further explanation. A card proposing that loyalty may include correction earns her crooked closed smile: a formation is either sound or somebody else's diagram. Hunky & Dory value her judgement after announcing their own. She rests a hand on the knob and watches the instructions meet the doorway.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Abweichung wurde früh erkannt. Ihre Zuständigkeit folgt später.

variant_notes.note_en: She knows where the order will fail and is waiting for permission to have noticed.

records.name: Aquilifer Würdentrag
records.biography_en: Würdentrag carries the HyperNorm eagle through corridors that were built before anyone measured its wings. A card allowing a symbol to mean different things makes his lower lip tremble: honour is either upright or slipping. Men in Black expect a reassuring standard. He looks up to check whether the bird has understood the responsibility, without receiving any useful assistance.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Würde wird getragen. Der Adler trägt bisher nichts bei.

variant_notes.note_en: He worries that the symbol is depending on him more personally than regulations intended.

records.name: Cornicen Pausius
records.biography_en: Pausius holds the HyperNorm horn at belly height and waits for a reason worthy of its volume. A card suggesting that communication can begin with silence earns his enormous pout: an assembly is either called or mercifully postponed. Hunky & Dory demand a rallying note. He adjusts the bell, preserving another short interval in which nobody has misunderstood him yet.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Signal ist vorbereitet. Die Stille erfüllt bislang alle Aufgaben.

variant_notes.note_en: He has discovered that a signal is easiest to interpret before anybody plays it.

records.name: Legionär Dienstus Zweifel
records.biography_en: Dienstus keeps his HyperNorm shield close enough to inspect while the pilum waits at his other side. A card suggesting that protection can also obstruct a view leaves him peering downward: equipment is either regulation or insufficient. Men in Black praise his preparedness. He clenches his teeth and tries to see around the very object meant to reassure him.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Schutz ist vollständig. Die Übersicht wurde dahinter vermutet.

variant_notes.note_en: He is prepared to hold the line once somebody explains which side he belongs on.

records.name: Tribunin Aktena
records.biography_en: Aktena receives HyperNorm complaints on a wax tablet with room for one more careful distinction. A card proposing that a record can preserve uncertainty strains her shallow diplomatic smile: a matter is either entered or nonexistent. Hunky & Dory appreciate tidy outcomes. She holds the stylus above the untouched wax, briefly allowing the unresolved thing to keep its own shape.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Vorgang ist offen. Seine Erledigung wurde bereits freundlich angekündigt.

variant_notes.note_en: She can record almost any disagreement in a form that appears to have concluded it.
